2610.06679.title: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
2610.06679.paper_summary: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.
2610.06679.paper_summary_zh: 表格基礎模型通過根據提供的標記訓練示例進行條件預測來執行上下文學習（ICL）。與將訓練與推理分開的傳統模型不同，這些模型必須在每次前向傳遞中處理所有訓練示例，這使得每次預測的成本變得昂貴。限制訓練示例的數量可以降低這一成本，但會大幅降低性能。我們提出了一種激活對齊的方法，該方法利用完整的上下文來教導模型在僅看到子集時如何行為，而不是丟棄上下文。這是通過在合成無標籤數據上訓練輕量級線性變換來實現的，將數據約束的“學生”（使用部分上下文）的中間激活映射到完整上下文的“教師”（使用所有數據）的中間激活。訓練對齊器不需要GPU，並且在普通硬件上在幾秒到幾分鐘內收斂。我們在TabArena基準上使用領先的兩個表格基礎模型TabPFN-3和TabFM對38個分類數據集進行評估。在所有上下文預算中，對齊的學生在這兩個模型上都帶來了相對於未對齊基線的廣泛且具有統計意義的改進。在低數據環境中，對齊幾乎恢復了教師預測優勢的一半。該方法提供了一種實用的低開銷方法，以實現緊湊上下文的推理速度，同時縮小與完整上下文教師之間的性能差距。
2610.06679.author: Yoel Zeldes et.al.
